clips.title: The story
paras: At the Crossroads, Thork keeps watch over the settlement’s defenses. He sends Horde adventurers against raiders and works to keep supply routes open.

Thork commands the defenses at the Crossroads, where roads link Durotar, Mulgore, and lands beyond. The town faces threats from every side. Quilboar raids, centaur attacks, and harpies on the prowl stretch his forces thin. Thork calls on capable travelers to meet dangers his guards cannot handle alone.

Thork’s watch reaches beyond the Crossroads walls. He sends scouts and messengers north to the Mor’shan Rampart, where they report to Kadrak. The northern and eastern routes carry supplies through the Barrens. Keeping those roads open sustains the Horde’s presence across the scrublands.
